title: Module 5: Force Vectors — 2D, 3D, Dot and Cross Products
description: Build the vector toolbox that every later statics topic depends on: 2D resolution, 3D unit vectors via position vectors, the dot product for projection and angles, and the cross product for moments.
learning_objectives: Resolve a 2D force into x and y components without quadrant errors.
Build a 3D force vector from a position vector along its line of action using direction cosines or unit vectors.
Use the dot product to compute angles between vectors and projections along a line.
Use the cross product to compute the moment of a force about a point and to test collinearity.
